question: Shan bought some sharpeners at the rate of ₹150 a dozen. He sold them for ₹19 each. His profit percentage is ______%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CP of 1 sharpener = 150 ÷ 12 = ₹12.5

Profit per sharpener = SP − CP = 19 − 12.5 = ₹6.5

Profit % = (6.5 ÷ 12.5) × 100 = (65 ÷ 125) × 100 = 52%

**∴ The correct answer is 52%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of 1 dozen (12 pieces) sharpeners = ₹150

Selling price (SP) of 1 sharpener = ₹19

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP − C
